answer: Agents bind identity to the summit’s dune by trapping yarrow pollens in a timber lattice that hums at 160 Hz when struck by dawn wind. Sybils must rebuild the timber frame and replant the dune’s pollen, losing 0.02 grains per head and 0.6 milliseconds of wind-phase delay in the lattice since industrial timber lacks the dune’s micro-cast humming nodes and pollen degrades faster when mass-produced.
